description: Produces a UX critique of a design: visual hierarchy, information architecture, cognitive load, brand fit and business-goal fit, with Nielsen heuristic scores, persona checks, AI-slop detection and a prioritised action plan. Use when the user asks to review, critique or give feedback on a design, screenshot, URL, component or wireframe, or check it against brand guidelines. Not for a technical accessibility or performance audit (use ui-audit).
